messages:
Sophia (security): Heads-up: rolling out the new Privileged Access Policy for Private deployments next week. TL;DR: enforced ephemeral operator creds, bastion-only SSH, KMS-derived admin keys, audit retention defaults, and tighter request-scoped approvals. Details below.

Jordan (product): Is this targeted at new installs only or will existing on-prem clusters be migrated?

Sophia (security): Both. New installs default to the policy. Existing clusters will receive an opt-in migration window with an automated migration tool and an audit report.

Kai (eng-oncall): When's the migration window? We need runbook updates and oncall playbooks.

Sophia (security): Migration staging: 2026-05-12 -> 2026-05-26 by region. Read-only preview mode available 2026-05-10. Runbook draft linked in the doc (internal).

Henry (solutions eng): Can CS get a simple customer checklist? Also requested: a 'legacy-mode' emergency rollback flag customers can use.

Sophia (security): Checklist added to the customer pack. 'legacy-mode' exists but is restricted (enterprise only) and requires 2-person approval + audit event.

Olivia (customer-success): We'll need an email cadence for customers >1k tokens/day. Can we send a heads-up tomorrow with an FAQ?

Jordan (product): I'll draft the email. @Olivia please review. cc: @Michael (legal) for compliance language.

Michael (legal): Reviewing retention & PII handling now. We need to confirm configurable retention per contract; will aim to sign off by EOD Friday.

DevOps-Bot: Deploy job #4289 queued for 2026-05-10 02:00 UTC to canary cluster.

Kai (eng-oncall): Add SRE alerts for failed key rotations and bastion auth spikes. Also update tracing for operator-sourced requests.

Sophia (security): Agreed. We'll add dashboard tiles in Console and a per-tenant migration progress view. SRE PR link: https://internal.redwood/PR/3245

Henry (solutions eng): Quick technical Q: air-gapped/on-prem customers — does the new policy mandate outbound KMS?

Sophia (security): No. Air-gapped customers can use local HSM or an offline attestation flow with customer-managed KMS. Docs include sample config and attestation checklist.

Olivia (customer-success): :thumbsup: Planning two office hours: 2026-05-11 16:00 UTC and 2026-05-18 09:00 UTC to walk customers through the migration. I'll post calendar invites.

Jordan (product): We'll expose migration status in Console (per-tenant) and an opt-in toggle during the window.

Sophia (security): Action items: 1) Product: customer notify + email template (Jordan). 2) CS: schedule pre-check calls + office hours (Olivia). 3) Eng: runbook, alerts, and canary deploy (Kai). 4) Security: final sign-off, audit hooks, and doc updates (Sophia). 5) Legal: retention review + contract flags (Michael).

Kai (eng-oncall): Runbook PR opened, ETA 2026-05-07. I'll add playbook snippets for oncall and escalation.

Michael (legal): Legal note: retention defaults must be configurable per contract and surfaced in the migration report.

DevOps-Bot: Canary deploy succeeded on 2026-05-10 02:45 UTC.

Olivia (customer-success): Thanks all — I'll coordinate invites and customer-facing material.

Sophia (security): :partyparrot: This reduces blast radius for operator mistakes and helps with ISO/SOC compliance targets. We'll post final docs after legal sign-off.
